1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000020_WUKLAMAT
1.description: We just heard she was busy spreading talk of becoming Endless among the Alexandrians. What's going on here?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000030_YSHTOLA
2.description: She...is not who you think she is.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000040_YSHTOLA
3.description: Not the Queen of Reason who has made a miraculous return, but an individual of flesh and blood, possessed of a soul.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000050_YSHTOLA
4.description: We chanced upon her in Living Memory, but she collapsed before we could exchange words. We decided to bring her here for now.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000060_ALISAIE
5.description: Her body was suffused with lightning aether, which caused a debilitating paralysis.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000070_ALISAIE
6.description: Y'shtola reached out and informed me of her condition, and I came with a porxie as fast as I could. We're now waiting to see if the treatment was effective.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000080_YSHTOLA
7.description: Judging by her appearance, the circumstances of our encounter, and her extreme aetherial aspect...

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000090_YSHTOLA
8.description: ...I am all but certain that she is the one from whom the Endless Sphene was created─the original Queen Sphene of Alexandria.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000100_WUKLAMAT
9.description: What!? But how can that be possible?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000110_WUKLAMAT
10.description: The real Sphene died of illness four centuries ago!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000180_ALISAIE
17.description: Calm down─we mean you no harm. You've been unwell, and it wouldn't do to strain yourself.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000190_ORIGINALSPHENE
18.description: (-Familiar-looking Woman-)Please...help me. I don't understand...any of this...

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000200_YSHTOLA
19.description: Of course. But if I might confirm some things first... You are Queen Sphene of Alexandria, are you not?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000220_YSHTOLA
21.description: And ere you awoke here, you were in another unfamiliar place. Is that correct?

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000230_ORIGINALSPHENE
22.description: I opened my eyes...and saw a strange, dark room. Outside, there were towering buildings...clad in electrope...

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000240_YSHTOLA
23.description: You slumbered at the heart of that city for many years, within a facility called the Meso Terminal.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000250_YSHTOLA
24.description: Many things have come to pass during that time...some of which you may find upsetting. Are you sure you wish to learn of them?

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000260_SHALE
25.description: In that dark room, there was an electrope casket designed to preserve its occupant in cold stasis.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000270_SHALE
26.description: Until the terminal and its systems were recently shut down, that was where you were kept, in all likelihood.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000280_SHALE
27.description: Since the time of the old kingdom, for four centuries...

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000300_ORIGINALSPHENE
29.description: I've been asleep for that long...? Four hundred years?

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000310_SHALE
30.description: Our records say that Queen Sphene succumbed to the rampant lightning energies unleashed during the Storm Surge. But it seems the truth is rather different.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000320_WUKLAMAT
31.description: I know this has all been a lot to take in, but how are you feeling? Physically, I mean.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000330_ORIGINALSPHENE
32.description: Much better now, thanks to Y'shtola and Alisaie's ministrations. In fact, I can scarcely remember the last time I felt so hale.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000340_ORIGINALSPHENE
33.description: I know not how to repay them... Not only for coming to my aid, but for telling me about my kingdom besides...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000350_WUKLAMAT
34.description: I don't think they're ones to keep score. Isn't that right?

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
37.description: Alisaie never abandons those in need.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
38.description: They're comrades you can rely on!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000360_WUKLAMAT
39.description: <hex:020810E905FF065368652773FF054865277303> known those two for a long time. You can trust in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> judgment.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000370_WUKLAMAT
40.description: Besides, you helped to prove that their treatment works here as well.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000380_WUKLAMAT
41.description: With this success, they'll be able to help others in Alexandria who suffer from the same illness. Few things could make them happier.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000390_ORIGINALSPHENE
42.description: I see... Full glad am I to know that we may cure the affliction after so long.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000410_ORIGINALSPHENE
44.description: I steeled myself, having been warned, but it's...difficult to come to terms with everything...

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000430_GULOOLJA
46.description: Maybe going out and seeing it would help. Alexandria, as it is now.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000440_WUKLAMAT
47.description: Great idea! There's no substitute for seeing things with your own eyes.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000450_WUKLAMAT
48.description: That said, there is a chance that you'll run into the other Sphene...

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000460_WUKLAMAT
49.description: Still want to take a look even so?

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000470_ORIGINALSPHENE
50.description: It would be a lie to say I do not feel anxious. But...I wish to walk among the people. To hear their voices and learn about their realm.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000490_WUKLAMAT
55.description: Then allow us to show you the sights!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000510_ORIGINALSPHENE
57.description: Apologies for keeping you waiting. I've never worn such clothing before...

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
61.description: It's like you're a different person.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
62.description: It looks ideal for a brisk afternoon stroll.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000540_ORIGINALSPHENE
64.description: I had much the same impression─I had only ever worn skirts, you see. But it seems appropriate for a new beginning...

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000550_ORIGINALSPHENE
65.description: For one so well traveled to say that, I feel confident it's perfect for exploring the city.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000560_SHALE
66.description: A moment before you head out.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000570_SHALE
67.description: Circumstances being what they are, we thought it best to come up with a way to distinguish you from the other Sphenes. And we should probably settle on this now rather than later.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000580_GULOOLJA
68.description: I suppose it could get pretty confusing...

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000590_SHALE
69.description: First, we propose calling you simply “Sphene.” As for the former Queen of Reason, “Endless Sphene” should suffice.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000600_WUKLAMAT
70.description: What about the new one who's been addressing the citizens?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000610_SHALE
71.description: Despite being the spitting image of Endless Sphene, we know she's a different entity. So we were thinking of calling her a “simulant,” after imitation stones.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000620_WUKLAMAT
72.description: I see... Well, they're definitely not the same, and that's as good a way as any to draw a distinction.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000630_WUKLAMAT
73.description: But what do you think, Sphene? Is that alright with you?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000640_ORIGINALSPHENE
74.description: Rest assured I have no objections. When I am in the city, however, I intend to keep both my face and name secret.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000650_ORIGINALSPHENE
75.description: For the people of today's Alexandria know only the Endless Sphene...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000660_SHALE
76.description: We're sorry to subject you to such ignominy...

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000670_ORIGINALSPHENE
77.description: No, no. I myself would rather not invite complications, so it is quite alright. Thank you for your concern, Shale.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000680_ORIGINALSPHENE
78.description: Let us be off, then. I am in your capable hands.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000690_WUKLAMAT
79.description: That you are. First, we'll head to the entrance of Solution Nine.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000700_GULOOLJA
80.description: Good idea. We should start from scanning port nine. I'll do my best to explain things!

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000710_ORIGINALSPHENE
81.description: So many different drinks. I can't decide...

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000730_ORIGINALSPHENE
83.description: I'll have this, please. A Dali coffee.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000740_DELIA
84.description: Of course. I should warn you, though─Dali beans are an older variety known for their strong bitterness. Still want one?

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000750_ORIGINALSPHENE
85.description: The bitterness is the best part.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A4_000_003_NONE_VOICE
90.description: Sweet cocoa with extra cream on top!

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000770_ORIGINALSPHENE
91.description: Two Dali coffees, then. The beans make for dark roasts that are quite aromatic. I find the sharp flavor invigorating, though a dash of milk can be a wonderful complement.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000780_ORIGINALSPHENE
92.description: Vegetable juice... Otis used to drink it all the time...

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000790_ORIGINALSPHENE
93.description: Ah, I understand completely. The allure of something sweet can often be too strong to resist.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000800_DELIA
94.description: I'll have your drinks ready in a moment!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000810_ORIGINALSPHENE
95.description: They're certainly well-liked. It's a wonderful feeling, spending time with the people...

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000830_ORIGINALSPHENE
97.description: But they're not my people anymore, are they? Their city, their way of life...even the ground upon which they tread... I am a stranger to it all...

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000840_ORIGINALSPHENE
98.description: The weight of the long years is finally beginning to sink in...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000870_ORIGINALSPHENE
101.description: I'm sorry to disappoint, but I am not Queen Sphene...though I'm often told we look alike.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000880_RESIDENTMAN05300
102.description: There you are! How many times have I told you not to go off alone!?

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000890_RESIDENTMAN05300
103.description: I'm sorry he bothered you, ma'am. Come now, we're going home!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000910_ORIGINALSPHENE
105.description: I do not know that boy, nor does he know me. No one does.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000920_ORIGINALSPHENE
106.description: Another harsh reminder that I have no place here...

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000930_ORIGINALSPHENE
107.description: Yet no matter how much things have changed, I am happy. I am. For Alexandria has endured. Our sacrifice was not in vain.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000940_ORIGINALSPHENE
108.description: Even so, I cannot help but feel lonely...

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000950_ORIGINALSPHENE
109.description: Not here... Let's press on, if only a little further.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_000990_NEWSPHENE
113.description: That was about the strongest bolt we can produce within Everkeep. What now?

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001000_CALYX
114.description: (-???-)We obtain more precise measurements. Narrow the range of variables to avoid unnecessary trial and error. That is the most expeditious course of action.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001030_NEWSPHENE
117.description: We have important business with you!

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001040_NEWSPHENE
118.description: We left something in your keeping─the key to interdimensional fusion. You will kindly return it to us, yes?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
121.description: You ask me that after you try to kill me?

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001050_NEWSPHENE
122.description: Is that so? What a shame.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001060_NEWSPHENE
123.description: Now that you mention it, the other way around may have been more appropriate.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001070_NEWSPHENE
124.description: If I had the key, I wouldn't need to be cruel and turn away so many people. Far more than five thousand could become Endless and know eternal happiness.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001080_WUKLAMAT
125.description: What!? You mean to steal aether from other worlds again!?

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001090_NEWSPHENE
126.description: All is for the sake of his experiments.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001100_NEWSPHENE
127.description: 'Twas for that reason, you know, that the previous me created the Endless.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001110_NEWSPHENE
128.description: I pity her. She was forced to attempt the impossible─to turn every soul who dies into an Endless even though there's no <hex:021A020203>end<hex:021A020103> to them.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001120_NEWSPHENE
129.description: Admittedly, that was part of the plan. Her desperation would drive her to claim the key and use it, and sure enough, she did just that.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001130_NEWSPHENE
130.description: I know you had a soft spot for her, Lamaty'i.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001135_NEWSPHENE
131.description: So for what it's worth, I'm <hex:021A020203>truly<hex:021A020103> sorry.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001140_NEWSPHENE
132.description: Alas, we are naught more than pawns. Pieces in his grand design.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001150_WUKLAMAT
133.description: Don't you dare make light of her love for her people! Don't you dare!

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001160_NEWSPHENE
134.description: Strike me down if you wish. I shall be made anew.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001170_NEWSPHENE
135.description: And I doubt many would look kindly upon the Vow of Resolve of Tuliyollal if she attacked a neighboring queen─and not for the first time. Would you be willing to accept the repercussions?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
138.description: What is the objective of these experiments?

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
139.description: What do you stand to gain by making everyone Endless?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001210_CALYX
142.description: (-???-)Our goal is to usher in the next phase of mankind's evolution.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001220_CALYX
143.description: (-???-)Since time immemorial, life has used death to facilitate adaptation in an ever-changing environment.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001230_CALYX
144.description: (-???-)The old and infirm are weeded out, allowing the species to thrive. Generational succession─this has been our survival strategy.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001240_CALYX
145.description: (-???-)Yet this strategy has long since reached its practical limit. It is outdated.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001250_CALYX
146.description: (-???-)It relies on progeny, which gives rise to unchecked population growth. Resources become scarce, invariably leading to conflict.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001260_CALYX
147.description: (-???-)All the while, death is ever present and robs our species of untold potential.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001270_CALYX
148.description: (-???-)Where man now stands in his evolution, bodies of flesh no longer make sense. What we must strive for next is carefully managed, eternal preservation.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001310_ORIGINALSPHENE
152.description: The young genius who had mastered electrope technology...

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001320_ORIGINALSPHENE
153.description: He founded the scientific collective known as Preservation, and devoted himself to developing a cure for the paralysis which plagued our people.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001330_ORIGINALSPHENE
154.description: Calyx! You always had your gaze set upon the future, and I know you do now.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001340_ORIGINALSPHENE
155.description: But I beg you, do not deceive the people of Alexandria! Do not manipulate them with this imitation forged from my memories!

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001350_NEWSPHENE
156.description: Well, how rude. Yet whatever you may say, I'm the one whom the people regard as queen.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001360_NEWSPHENE
157.description: You may have worn the crown for a few years, but now you are no one. Just a frail, fleshy version of me that could die at any moment. The kingdom has no use for such as you.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001370_CALYX
158.description: Our demand is simple: surrender the key. Refusal will necessitate consequences.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001380_KRILE
159.description: We've heard what happened. So, Preservation has revealed itself at last.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001390_GRAHATIA
160.description: And using the key, they mean to turn even more people into Endless...

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001400_GRAHATIA
161.description: It seems safe to assume that they, too, intend to steal aether from the other reflections.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001410_GRAHATIA
162.description: But unlike the previous Sphene, they have no intention of saving everyone.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001420_GRAHATIA
163.description: Calyx of all people would know precisely how much aether is required to sustain an Endless. Thus he is able to set a realistic limit to their creation, without being swayed by emotion.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001430_KRILE
164.description: Carefully managed, eternal preservation... Whether or not this can be considered an evolution, 'tis plain that man's very existence would be forever changed.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001440_WUKLAMAT
165.description: Say... If this Calyx is as brilliant a scientist as everyone says, could he have been the one who erased everyone's memories of Endless Sphene's death?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001450_ORIGINALSPHENE
166.description: That is a possibility, though I cannot speak to his motives...

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001460_KRILE
167.description: Though Calyx has outright stated his ultimate goal, how his actions will further this agenda remains unclear...

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001470_KRILE
168.description: That said, we have seen how anxiety towards death continues to spread amongst Alexandrians. Perhaps the simulant stokes this fear to entice them to become Endless.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001480_ORIGINALSPHENE
169.description: Everyone is afraid of death. We try to put it out of our minds, and I do not blame the people for feeling as they do.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001490_ORIGINALSPHENE
170.description: Nonetheless, I wish to stop the simulant. I wish to do what I can for those who believe in their queen.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001500_ORIGINALSPHENE
171.description: Although I wear no crown, were I to forsake the people...then I would truly have no place here.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001510_SHALE
172.description: I don't know if this will help in that endeavor, but I've found something interesting.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001520_SHALE
173.description: When I analyzed the sign that Calyx appeared on, I was able to determine the source of transmission. I traced it back to a terminal used only by Preservation, located in the foundation sector.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001530_GULOOLJA
174.description: Foundation sector... That came up in my mother's records, didn't it? It's where the old castle was hidden.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001540_SHALE
175.description: Everkeep was built atop the castle of the former kingdom. Access to the immediate area─the foundation sector─is highly restricted, with map data accordingly classified.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001550_ORIGINALSPHENE
176.description: The old castle is inside this tower...?

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001560_SHALE
177.description: It's an ideal place for Preservation to conceal a terminal, I must say. Having existed since the Storm Surge, they would be familiar with the castle's layout.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001570_KRILE
178.description: But I wonder, would someone so versed in electrope such as Calyx be so careless as to leave a trail?

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001580_SHALE
179.description: Oh, I expect he intended for us to find the terminal.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001590_GRAHATIA
180.description: It may be a trap, but it's our only lead. What do you think, my friend?

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
182.description: If we have a lead, I say we follow it!

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
183.description: We can't leave them to their own devices.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
184.description: I think a little revenge is in order.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001600_GRAHATIA
185.description: Agreed. And besides, you owe him for that bolt of lightning.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001610_GRAHATIA
186.description: No, we cannot. We must learn exactly what he is plotting.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001620_GRAHATIA
187.description: That it is. While I'm glad you're safe, we cannot allow his offense to go unanswered.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001630_SHALE
188.description: If you're set on this course of action, I'll work on getting you access to the foundation sector. Sit tight for now.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001640_ORIGINALSPHENE
189.description: Please let me come with you!

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001650_ORIGINALSPHENE
190.description: I may not possess any special skills, but I know the castle better than any. So please...

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001670_WUKLAMAT
192.description: If that's what you want, then we go together. The rest of us will take point and secure the way, and we'll count on you to guide us in the castle.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001680_CALYX
193.description: We still lack sufficient data. Very well. Let us see how you perform against this.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001690_CALYX
194.description: That will do. We have enough to proceed with an analysis.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001700_KRILE
195.description: Calyx was measuring our strength. Is that why he contrived to lead us here?

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001710_WUKLAMAT
196.description: It looks like we've cleared away the machines and beasts, but who knows what else he might have in store...

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001720_WUKLAMAT
197.description: From here on out, Sphene and Shale will move with us. Let's find that terminal, but stay alert for more threats.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001730_ORIGINALSPHENE
198.description: Before my illness left me bedridden, I used to walk through here on my way to watch Otis and Zelenia train.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001740_ORIGINALSPHENE
199.description: You knew Otis, if I am not mistaken? Zelenia was his second-in-command in the royal knights of Alexandria.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001750_ORIGINALSPHENE
200.description: Oh, how I loved to see the two of them spar. I once dreamed of fighting by their side, so I studied the magical arts under my tutor.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001760_ORIGINALSPHENE
201.description: But when I was fifteen, the Storm Surge broke out, and both my father and mother passed away.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001770_ORIGINALSPHENE
202.description: As the new queen, I was forbidden from taking to the battlefield, for our nation would fracture had I died without a successor.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001780_ORIGINALSPHENE
203.description: Though in the end I could barely move, I regret that I didn't go out there and fight. At least while I still could.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001790_ORIGINALSPHENE
204.description: My Endless self lamented not being able to protect the realm with benevolence. 'Tis a feeling to which I can relate...

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001810_ORIGINALSPHENE
206.description: Ah, forgive me! 'Twas not my intent to darken the mood. Come, let us press on.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001820_WUKLAMAT
207.description: This is one big castle, though... How far does this hallway go?

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001870_NEWSPHENE
211.description: Oh? It seems our guest brought company.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001890_NEWSPHENE
213.description: It was. We installed a teleporter that is triggered by the presence of the key, you see.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001900_NEWSPHENE
214.description: Ah, I'm afraid aetheric transmissions cannot penetrate the walls of the throne room. It will take your friends a good while to find you.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001910_CALYX
215.description: I confess, the Valia Pira did not suffice to assess your capabilities.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001920_CALYX
216.description: So I shall try something else.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001930_CALYX
217.description: You are free to use anything at your disposal. The better you fight, the more accurate my data.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001940_CALYX
218.description: Attaining a precise measure of your strength─that is the most expeditious way...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001950_CALYX
219.description: ...To reclaim the key to which you so stubbornly cling.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001960_NEWSPHENE
220.description: Ah, noble Zelenia, dashing as ever. These villains mean to do us harm. Strike them down, I bid you!

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001980_NEWSPHENE
222.description: Indeed it is. We couldn't preserve her memories while she lived, so she has been reconstructed from our recollections of her.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_001990_ORIGINALSPHENE
223.description: [SUPRESSING ANGER]ALT: [SUPPRESSING ANGER, GRUNTING THROUGH GRITTED TEETH]

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002000_ORIGINALSPHENE
224.description: The Endless me being created in answer to the earnest desires of Alexandrians... That, I can accept.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002010_ORIGINALSPHENE
225.description: But to twist the memories of those I held dear and treat them as playthings...

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002030_ORIGINALSPHENE
227.description: Loath though I am to comply with their demands, this monstrosity must be destroyed. Not least of all for Zelenia's honor.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002040_ORIGINALSPHENE
228.description: If she was indeed created from my memories, even if I cannot fight, I may be able to offer you counsel.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002050_ORIGINALSPHENE
229.description: So please, lend me your strength and end this farce!

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002080_ZELENIA
232.description: Royal knight of Alexandria, and sworn blade of Her Majesty the Queen.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002090_ZELENIA
233.description: A disgraceful display... Forgive me, my queen... I have failed you...

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002100_NEWSPHENE
234.description: Did you get what you needed?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002110_CALYX
235.description: I did. Though these figures will complicate matters.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002120_NEWSPHENE
236.description: Is that so? Well, if we are done here, then I shall end the transmission.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002140_ORIGINALSPHENE
238.description: If you have no scruples about thus defiling the memories of Zelenia...then there is no way we will ever see eye to eye.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002150_ORIGINALSPHENE
239.description: You are not fit to be entrusted with the cherished memories of Alexandrians!

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002160_CALYX
240.description: I, for one, have no wish to employ the fruits of my research in this manner. It is a waste of time and effort.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002170_CALYX
241.description: But since I relinquished my flesh long ago, I must resort to every conceivable method, so long as the hero insists on keeping the key.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002180_CALYX
242.description: Why do you so oppose our objective?

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002190_CALYX
243.description: With the key, we would be able to harvest aether from other reflections and bring forth more Endless.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002200_CALYX
244.description: We could give this chance to evolve not only to the people of the Ninth, but to those of the Source as well. I see no reason why you should reject such a boon.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
246.description: We won't let you lay a finger on the reflections!

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
247.description: You're aware of the connection between the worlds?

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002210_NEWSPHENE
248.description: How miserly you are! But unless you're willing to compromise, you won't be able to save anyone or anything.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002220_NEWSPHENE
249.description: Oh, don't tell me you thought you were the only ones who knew? That is the height of hubris!

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002230_NEWSPHENE
250.description: Well, I'd say our conversation has run its course.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002240_NEWSPHENE
251.description: Ultimately, what you think is immaterial, for the seeds we've sown have already quickened.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002250_NEWSPHENE
252.description: The people have glimpsed hope in transcending death, and they can ill turn away from it.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002260_NEWSPHENE
253.description: And thus does my role come to an end. The rest, I leave in your capable hands, Calyx.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002270_CALYX
254.description: As a token of gratitude for consenting to my tests, I leave you with a gift. Be sure to take it with you.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002280_ORIGINALSPHENE
255.description: Zelenia... It pains me to think that you're gone too...

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002290_WUKLAMAT
256.description: Ah hah! We've found you at last!

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002300_GRAHATIA
257.description: You had us quite worried when you suddenly disappeared. What in the world happened?

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002310_KRILE
258.description: Then Preservation's objective is indeed what Calyx claimed.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002320_KRILE
259.description: But for them to know about the Source and the shards, and to refer to theirs as the Ninth... That raises some questions.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002330_WUKLAMAT
260.description: Indeed. But for now, I'm just glad the two of you are safe.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002340_WUKLAMAT
261.description: Oh, right. While we were scouring the castle for you, we came upon a room that looked like a library.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002350_KRILE
262.description: By learning about the Alexandria of old, we may gain valuable insights into Preservation. Might we take a number of books with us?

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002360_ORIGINALSPHENE
263.description: So books still remain... Of course, you are welcome to any that may be of use.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002370_SHALE
264.description: If you don't mind, could we take a look around here first? I'm especially curious about the area over by the throne.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002380_WUKLAMAT
265.description: This tiara... It was hers─the Endless Sphene's... What's it doing here?

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002390_SHALE
266.description: It's a type of regulator, I believe.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002395_SHALE
267.description: It contains the data of the Endless Sphene's memories. Calyx likely used it to create the simulant.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002400_SHALE
268.description: Which means that, as long as the tiara is in our keeping, we shouldn't need to deal with any more simulants.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002410_SHALE
269.description: Strange that he would abandon it, though. Perhaps because the simulant already played her role, like she said. Or Calyx made a copy of the memories...

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002420_SHALE
270.description: In any case, not much information of import appears to remain on this terminal, but I'll make it so we can access it remotely from the Backroom.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002430_ORIGINALSPHENE
271.description: This contains the memories of another me... The tale of her journey as Queen of Alexandria...

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002440_ORIGINALSPHENE
272.description: Might I hold on to this tiara? You may examine it whenever you wish, of course.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002450_WUKLAMAT
273.description: It would be for the best, I think.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002460_WUKLAMAT
274.description: Does that work for you, Shale?

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002480_SHALE
276.description: Alright, I'm finished. Let's head to the library and then back outside.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002500_ISADORA
278.description: I once hoped that Milos, at least, might be made an Endless. Then he wouldn't need to suffer anymore.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002520_ISADORA
280.description: Thanks to Alisaie, Milos is on the road to recovery. He can grow up and live a normal life.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002530_ISADORA
281.description: And I want to be there with him every step of the way. To grow old with him, as his mother...and not something else.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002540_ALISAIE
282.description: That should do it. You're doing well, I'm glad to say.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002560_ALISAIE
284.description: You're welcome, Milos. Now, you'll feel breathless for a little while still, but don't fret. It'll get easier to speak with time.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002570_ALISAIE
285.description: That said, we can't rule out the possibility of a relapse. As a precaution, I would keep him away from lightning-infused objects.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002590_ALISAIE
287.description: It does. I understand if it's difficult for you to part with something that you've worn for so long, though, so it's entirely up to you...

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002600_ISADORA
288.description: No. For Milos's sake, I will do it. And if the environment here isn't good for him, I must consider moving outside the dome.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002610_WUKLAMAT
289.description: You two would be more than welcome in Tuliyollal!

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002620_ISADORA
290.description: It's very assuring to hear that. If you don't mind, could you tell me about the process?

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002640_MILOS
292.description: Before, I couldn't even thank my mother for caring for me...

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002650_MILOS
293.description: But now we can talk lots... I can tell her that I'm happy... That I like it when she strokes my hair...

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002660_ALISAIE
294.description: Your mother is happy to talk to you as well, I'm sure.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002670_MILOS
295.description: Queen Sphene always cheered me up... Always said that she would cure me...

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002680_MILOS
296.description: Today, I'll practice walking with Mother... And next time, I'll go and visit you...

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002700_WUKLAMAT
298.description: We'll come again to check on you, so if you have any other questions, just let me know!

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002710_WUKLAMAT
299.description: Right, let's get going, shall we?

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002720_MILOS
300.description: Please come back soon... You too, miss...

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002730_WUKLAMAT
301.description: It's good to see Milos doing so well.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002740_ORIGINALSPHENE
302.description: The Endless me gave him the strength to hang on, and she didn't rely on any special power to do so...

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002760_WUKLAMAT
304.description: She wanted her people to be happy. Even though we had to fight, her love for them was very real, and it reached Milos.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002770_ORIGINALSPHENE
305.description: I wish to be there to watch him grow as well. To make my way beside the people of Alexandria.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002780_ORIGINALSPHENE
306.description: In the name of his evolution, Calyx has wrought much unease and misery, and I cannot condone his path.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002790_ORIGINALSPHENE
307.description: No, I shall forge ahead on a path of my own─one that honors the memory of my other self!

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002830_ANNOUNCER
308.description: (-Announcer-)Citizens of Alexandria, please be advised. The distribution of neo regulators has concluded.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002840_ANNOUNCER
309.description: (-Announcer-)We ask that all recipients equip their regulators and promptly complete device registration.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002850_ANNOUNCER
310.description: (-Announcer-)The evolution of our kind is at hand. Together we shall rise above death, and bask in the infinite possibilities of eternal life!

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002880_BEWILDERMENT05306
313.description: Those with neo regulators will become Endless, apparently...

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002890_IRRITATION05306
314.description: You mean there's no more!? Well, don't you feel lucky!

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002900_TREPIDATION05306
315.description: D-Don't look at me like that! Queen Sphene said there were only so many...

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002910_CALMNESS05306
316.description: I haven't registered mine yet. The more I thought about it, the more unsure I felt about becoming an Endless.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002920_TIMID05306
317.description: Well, I registered right away. Anything to stop those terrible nightmares of being killed by mechanical soldiers.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002930_NEWSPHENE
318.description: (-Simulant-)Ultimately, what you think is immaterial, for the seeds we've sown have already quickened.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002940_NEWSPHENE
319.description: (-Simulant-)The people have glimpsed hope in transcending death, and they can ill turn away from it.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002950_ORIGINALSPHENE
320.description: I see... The terror of their first encounter with death still lingers in their hearts.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002960_ORIGINALSPHENE
321.description: Having previously been spared even the idea of it, they know not how to handle the emotions.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002970_WUKLAMAT
322.description: The funeral was meant to give everyone the chance to come to terms with loss. To grieve and move forward together...

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002980_WUKLAMAT
323.description: But everyone who was wearing a regulator had their memories of that moment erased.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002990_WUKLAMAT
324.description: And to see those oblivious, happy souls, those who remembered must've wondered if it might not be better to be like them. To go back to a time when death didn't exist.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003000_ALISAIE
325.description: And now they've been presented with the chance to do just that, by becoming an Endless. It's not hard to see why they would consider it.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003010_ORIGINALSPHENE
326.description: If this fear of death continues to spread among the people, what will become of Alexandria...?

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003020_ORIGINALSPHENE
327.description: The gifts for our friends will have to wait. We should return to the Backroom at once.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_002800_TREPIDATION05306
328.description: What is that?ALT: What was that?

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003030_SHALE
331.description: Oh, you're safe! That broadcast had us worried. The entire populace is on edge.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003040_ALISAIE
332.description: So Alphinaud and the others are still out there...

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003050_NOSTALGIA
333.description: We have a situation on our hands!

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003060_NOSTALGIA
334.description: A civilian has been killed by a mechanical soldier here on True Vue!

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003070_NOSTALGIA
335.description: Wayakkwe is on the scene, and reports that the problem unit has been subdued by another sentry.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003080_GULOOLJA
336.description: That doesn't make sense... Only someone with the King of Resolve's authority could order a soldier to do that!

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003090_SHALE
337.description: Not good. I tried to check the status of the authority, but was blocked from the core system.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003100_SHALE
338.description: Given recent developments, I'd wager that Calyx is responsible for this.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003110_ORIGINALSPHENE
339.description: Perhaps we should go and see for ourselves.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003120_ERENVILLE
340.description: (-Erenville-)It's me. There's been an incident in the outskirts...

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003130_ERENVILLE
341.description: (-Erenville-)A mechanical soldier attacked a local resident for no apparent reason.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003140_ERENVILLE
342.description: (-Erenville-)Fortunately, several nearby hunters dealt with the rogue machine, so everyone is safe. But if other soldiers were to─

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003160_ERENVILLE
344.description: (-Erenville-)More hostile sentries are bound for the settlement. I'll try to lure them away and then lose them somehow.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003190_SHALE
347.description: You'll go and help Erenville, won't you? We couldn't forgive ourselves if he came to harm. I'll have Geode join you from Earthen Sky.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003200_GULOOLJA
348.description: I'm coming, too! I can't stay here while my people are in danger!

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003220_ERENVILLE
350.description: Right, we're none the worse for the wear, but let's see what the situation is here.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003230_ORIGINALSPHENE
351.description: Geode and his people came and joined us while we were searching for you.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003240_ORIGINALSPHENE
352.description: After which we happened to encounter Malachite. His usher duties brought him here, and he has quite the story to tell.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003250_MALACHITE
353.description: It's a bit puzzling, to say the least. Even so, I'll try my best to explain.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003260_MALACHITE
354.description: I was called to attend to the unfortunate soul slain by the mechanical soldier.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003270_MALACHITE
355.description: Yet when I arrived, I found no body. Only a pile of dust, which the wind quickly scattered.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003280_MALACHITE
356.description: Confused, I questioned the residents, but none knew what had become of it.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003290_ALISAIE
357.description: How odd... Did they remember the victim, at least?

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003300_MALACHITE
358.description: They did. Their memories of the deceased weren't sent to the cloud, I don't believe. Yet no body remained...

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003310_WUKLAMAT
359.description: If someone took it, surely they would've been noticed...

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003320_MALACHITE
360.description: With your permission, I shall return to the government sector for now. Please take care.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003330_GULOOLJA
361.description: This is terrible... Why would they make the soldiers do this?

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003340_GEODE
362.description: If Preservation is behind the attacks, I fear this won't be the end of it.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003350_ORIGINALSPHENE
363.description: All the neo regulators have been distributed, and potentially five thousand Endless are about to be born. What does Calyx hope to achieve with these killings?

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003360_ORIGINALSPHENE
364.description: Does he seek to frighten people into registering them? Or perhaps...

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003370_GRAHATIA
365.description: (-G'raha Tia-)Oh, thank the Twelve you answered! Shale told me what happened. Is everything all right?

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003380_GRAHATIA
366.description: (-G'raha Tia-)...I see. 'Tis a relief to hear that Erenville is safe. Alas, I do not have good news to share in return...

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003390_GRAHATIA
367.description: (-G'raha Tia-)A driver lost control of his vehicle when its interface became unresponsive, and it crashed into the Nexus Arcade, injuring several people.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003400_GRAHATIA
368.description: (-G'raha Tia-)Krile and I are helping to render aid, but with the sentries behaving strangely, we can't afford to lower our guard. Remain vigilant, my friend.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003410_GEODE
369.description: I just received word from the Backroom. A hover cargo on True Vue threw off its driver, and it's rampaging through the area as we speak.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003420_ALISAIE
370.description: Alphinaud had a similarly troubling report for me. Apparently, a riderless machine in the government sector came to life near a crowd clamoring for neo regulators.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003430_ALISAIE
371.description: It proceeded to mow down several citizens, causing serious injuries.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003440_ORIGINALSPHENE
372.description: This is a tragedy... We must go and help the people!

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003450_WUKLAMAT
373.description: Sphene, wait! I'm coming with you!

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003460_ALISAIE
374.description: Alphinaud is with Y'shtola, and he said they'll be all right. I'll go and see if other incidents have occurred elsewhere.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003470_ALISAIE
375.description: From here, I'll head towards the quarry by way of the driftdowns.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003480_GEODE
376.description: Certainly a lot of hover cargos coming and going in those parts. I'll join you.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003490_ERENVILLE
377.description: I shall remain here and speak further with the locals. I have company now, so you needn't worry about me.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003500_GULOOLJA
378.description: Then let's return to Solution Nine! If we hurry, we can catch up to Lamaty'i and Sphene.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003510_WUKLAMAT
379.description: Sphene's gone on ahead! I leave her with you!

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003580_YSHTOLA
384.description: Surely there's a finite number of these things...

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003590_GOSSAN
385.description: Everyone, please try to remain calm and make your way to Resolution!

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003600_TURMOIL05306
386.description: This is just like before...when Zoraal Ja unleashed the soldiers on us!

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003610_TURMOIL05306
387.description: I don't have any souls left! I don't want to die! I don't want to die!

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003650_CONFUSION05306
391.description: No, no─why did you do that? Why!? You can't just...just leave me alone like this...

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003660_CONFUSION05306
392.description: If we had been Endless, then you'd still be here...you'd still be with me... But now...

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003690_ORIGINALSPHENE
395.description: So many hurt... So many dead...

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003700_ORIGINALSPHENE
396.description: This is wrong! This is all wrong!

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003810_CALYX
411.description: By illness weakened, by wounds unmade, by age decayed...

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003820_CALYX
412.description: Such fragile flesh is worthless to us.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003825_CALYX
413.description: How mankind should evolve─<hex:021A020203>shall<hex:021A020103> evolve─I have already arrived at the answer.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07200_003830_CALYX
414.description: The time is come to pose a new question.
